title: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not check that a visitor is really the subscriber before showing…
description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin versions before 9.4.0 have a vulnerability where the plugin does not properly verify that a visitor is the legitimate subscriber before displaying newsletters marked as private. Attackers who know a subscriber's email address can exploit this by submitting the email to the public subscription form to obtain a weaker subscriber identifier, allowing them to access all private newsletters sent to that subscriber.
